text.p: VANCOUVER, Oct 7 ( euter) - TimberWest Forest Ltd and Fletcher Challenge Canada Ltd said Monday they formed a joint committee to oversee previously announced efforts to find a buyer for TimberWest.

Fletcher owns 52 percent of TimberWest and is itself in turn majority owned by New Zealand's Fletcher Challenge Ltd. The committee consists of two of Fletcher Canada's representatives on the TimberWest board, David Leighton and Luke Moriarty, and two independent directors, Bill Brown and Stephen Bellringer. TimberWest has retained RBC Dominion Securities Inc to advise it.
TimberWest and Fletcher Canada announced last Friday they would search for a buyer for TimberWest, a lumber producer, and would consider all alternatives with a view to maximizing shareholder value.
